content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Donations ## slug: event-donations ## seoTitle: Donations ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Out of the box, you can create a {{variable.Object_Donation}}, provide a description, define the sales start and end dates, and track the quantity sold. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} purchases a Donation, the following occurs. * The Donation becomes a {{variable.Object_LineItem}} on the related {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. * The new {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_Donated}} checkbox is checked. Separate {{variable.Object_Contact}} and {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records for the Donation are not created. In addition to the items just described, we also provide the features covered below. ## Pre-requisites If an {{variable.Object_Event}} includes a free {{variable.Object_EventItem}} (Main event ticket) and a Donation {{variable.Object_EventItem}}, a {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} is required in order to publish the {{variable.Object_Event}}. ### Sandbox If you create an {{variable.Object_EventItem}} with {{variable.Field_EventItem_Address}} set to “Optional” or “Required” in a Sandbox, you must set the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Country}} field to “Required.” You will get an error if the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Country}} field is set to “Hide” (default setting). ## Event Page Layout The section “Donations” was added to the {{variable.Object_Event}} page layout. The Products section will include the following fields: {{variable.Field_LineItem_LineItemName}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_Attendee}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_AttendeeFullNam}}, {{variable.Field_LineItem_Event}}, and {{variable.Field_LineItem_UnitPrice}}. ![Donations Section on Event Object](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Donations%20Section%20on%20Event%20Object.png){height="" width=""} * * * ![ev1807 pic 5_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/ev1807%20pic%205_1.png){height="" width=""} ### New Fields You may need to manually add new fields to the Attendee page layout as they may not be added by default. #### Event Item Type * Field Label: {{variable.Field_LineItem_EventItemType}} * Field Name: conference360__Event_Item_Type__c * Data Type: Formula(Text) * Location: {{variable.Object_LineItem}} object * Purpose: a text formula field that shows the type of {{variable.Object_EventItem}} ![Line Item_Donations](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Line%20Item_Donations.png){height="" width=""} #### Donated * Field Label: {{variable.Field_Attendee_Donated}} * Field Name: conference360__Donated__c * Data Type: Checkbox * Location: {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object * Purpose: a checkbox field that shows whether an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} gave a Donation ![Attendee_Donations](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Attendee_Donations.png){height="" width=""} ## Functionality ### Event Item Record * If a {{variable.Object_Donation}} is added to the Event Item, it will be carried to the Line Item on the Invoice. * The Event Item Type for a {{variable.Object_Donation}} is “Donation”. ### Line Item Record * The {{variable.Field_LineItem_Event}} lookup field has been added to the Line Item record to show which Event the Donation is related to. ### Checkout Process * Registrants can either choose from a list of pre-selected amounts or enter a unique amount for a {{variable.Object_Donation}}. * Images are now supported during checkout. * A Donation’s information is added to a selected {{variable.Object_Attendee}} when the Donation is added to the cart. * If a Donation’s information has not been added to an {{variable.Object_Attendee}}, the Donation’s Information will be added to the first {{variable.Object_Attendee}}. * {{variable.Object_EventItem_Donation}} data will be added to the checkout payload. * Custom Forms are supported for {{variable.Object_EventItem_Donation}}s. ### Split Payments Split Payments allows users to define how to reconcile funds from different purchases (e.g., Tickets, Donations, Products) to specific gateway accounts connected to separate bank accounts. The benefits of using Split Payments include the following. * Allow {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to pay using both a primary {{variable.Field_EventItem_PaymentGateway}} and a {{variable.Field_EV_DonationPaymentGatewa}} during a single checkout experience. * Improve the user experience by eliminating the need to enter payment details multiple times. [Click here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-items-split-payments){target=`_blank`} for more information about and how to use Split Payments. ## Create a Donation 1. Once a Main event ticket has been created, open a New Event Item window and add the following information to create a {{variable.Object_EventItem_Donation}}. ### Information & Description * Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_PublicItemNa}} (required). * Select an {{variable.Object_Event}}. * Enter an amount in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Price}} field. (Donation amounts can include two decimal points. Ex. $22.50) * Set {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = "Donation". * Select a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_VisibilityCo}}, if using. * Check {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_WaitlistEnab}} to enable waitlisting. * Enter a {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Description}}. * Enter a value in the {{variable.Field_EventItem_SortOrder}} field to change the order of the {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s on the registration page. ![Event Item Object_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Item%20Object_2.png){height="" width=""} ### Availability & Limits {{snippet.EV_EventItem_Create_AvailLimit}} ### Capacity & Waitlisting {{snippet.EV_EventItem_Create_CapWaitlis}} ![Event Item_Avail and Capacity](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Item_Avail%20and%20Capacity.png){height="" width=""} ### Attendee Form There are multiple fields on the Attendee Form that you can hide, make required, or show as optional for each Donation. For example, if you have a "Child Under 3 Yrs" ticket for sale, it is very unlikely that the child does not have an email address. You can hide the {{variable.Field_EventItem_Email}} field from this Event Item's Attendee Form. ![Event Item_Attendee Form Settings ](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Event%20Item_Attendee%20Form%20Settings%20.png){height="" width=""} {{snippet.EV_EventItem_Create_AttendForm}} #### Live Attendee Form Example ![View Live Attendee Form\(2\)](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/View%20Live%20Attendee%20Form%282%29.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click **Save & New** to create a new Event Item or click **Save**. ### Other Settings * Select a previously created {{variable.Object_Form}} or create a new one. [Click here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/custom-questions){target=`_blank`} for more information about creating {{variable.Object_Form}}s and {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s. * Check {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Hidden}} if you want to hide the {{variable.Object_EventItem}} from the {{variable.Object_Event}} checkout process. * To set a minimum or a maximum number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s allowed per order, enter the amounts in the {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} and/or {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MinQuantity}} fields. * An {{variable.Object_EventItem}}’s {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_QuantiRemain}} will show on the registration page only when there are 10 or fewer {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s available. * The {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_MaxQuantity}} or number of {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s that can be purchased at one time cannot be larger than 10. Please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} if you would like to increase the number to 25. * If you want the Donations and Products sections to be on their own pages, set {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_EVSetting_DisplayDPsepar}} separately to “Yes” (checked). To continue using the current functionality, leave {{variable.Field_EVSetting_DisplayDPsepar}} separately set to “No” (unchecked). * Note: If a {{variable.Object_Form}} is related to a Donation or Product record, the {{variable.Object_Form}} will be displayed on the page with the Donation or Product.
